values.note: Reserve through the form on the park's website (arrival date, nights, camper length; confirmation by email) or call (719) 346-0116. Self-registration, so late arrivals are fine; check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m., no arrivals before 1:30 p.m.

note: Small locally owned RV park on US-24 (Rose Ave) in east Burlington, 2½ blocks from I-70 exit 438, away from the truck-stop strip at the west exit. Self-contained rigs only. No permanent residents. --Claude
